title: XVIII. Of obtaining eternal Salvation only by the name of Chriſt.

segments.text: THey alſo are to be had accurſed, that preſume to ſay, That every man ſhall be ſaved by the Law or Sect which he profeſſeth, ſo that he be diligent to frame his life according to that Law, and the light of nature: For holy Scripture doth ſet out unto us only the Name of Jeſus Chriſt, whereby men muſt be ſaved.
